name: VitePress
description: VitePress is a Vite and Vue powered static site generator that turns Markdown into fast static HTML pages.
notes: firstRelease from npm vitepress creation (2020-04-30); the oldest GitHub release is v0.7.3 (2020-11-16). This setup uses a minimal custom theme (bare layout rendering the page content) and a createContentLoader data file for the index; no default theme, search or sidebar.
